text:
alisa: quick note 1 observed inconsistent evict behavior during tenant surge; some nodes hard-evicted prefixes immediately while others applied soft leases and we saw read-after-evict errors. thinking we need a tiny cross-node 'evict-candidate' signal to coordinate.

jamal: minimal proto?

alisa: idea: { prefix: 'tenant:77:cart', reason: 'mem', score: 0.84, last_seen: 1799001000, kind: 'candidate' } - very small, meant to be piggybacked on heartbeats.

henry: piggyback on heartbeat makes sense to avoid mesh storm. include only top-k candidates per beat.
jamal: tie-breaker concern if nodes disagree on action. need deterministic ordering to avoid flip-flop.

alisa: tie-break = (node_uuid, beat_seq) lexicographic + short hysteresis (2s) before hard-evict so late beats can win. persist last_action in ephemeral map.

henry: fallback: if local read qps high, downgrade hard-evict -> soft-evict. expose tenant policy (aggressive|default|conservative).

alisa: test plan: unit tests for tie-breaker, 100-node microbench for heartbeat growth, and chaos partition test. I'll spike piggyback and publish metrics.

ops-bot: <alert>sampling job recorded ~11k candidate signals/min during replay 1 filed INC-2026-43</alert>

jamal: good. keep v1 tiny; we can add optional hash later if needed.

alisa: will follow up with short RFC and spike results.
